subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 5: Project – A desk tidy + Sound b
outcomes: I can say what I've got: I've got a pen.
I can name crayon, pen, pencil, eraser and ruler.
I can hear the b sound in bird, boy and ball.

tf.s: We can say: I've got a ruler.
tf.why: Yes! I've got a … tells what you have.

tf.s: We keep pens and pencils in a desk tidy.
tf.why: Great! A desk tidy keeps our things tidy.

tf.s: Ball starts with the b sound.
Goat starts with the b sound.
tf.why: Goat starts with g. Boy starts with b.

tf.s: b – a – t makes the word bat.
b – i – n makes the word big.
tf.why: b-i-n makes bin. b-i-g makes big.

tf.s: An eraser is a toy animal.
tf.why: An eraser is a school thing. It rubs out pencil.

tf.s: Book and bag start with the same letter.
Shell starts with the letter b.
Crayon, pen and pencil are school things.
tf.why: Right! We use them in class.

boxes.q: b – i – g. What's the word?
You have a pen. What do you say?

boxes.why: The desk tidy is on the desk.

hunt.q: A child that starts with b

mcq.q: What sound does the book card show?
Which one is a school thing?
mcq.why: A pencil is a school thing.

mcq.q: Which word starts with the same sound as boy?
mcq.why: Boy and ball both start with b.

mcq.q: What is the first letter of octopus?
Your partner holds up a crayon. What's this?
Listen: b – a – t. What's the word?
You show your desk tidy. You have a pen and a ruler. What do you say?
o: I've got a pen and a ruler.
mcq.why: I've got … tells what is in your desk tidy.

mcq.q: Which word does NOT start with b?
mcq.why: Goat starts with g. The others start with b.

mcq.q: Which words start with sh, g and b?
mcq.why: Ship starts with sh, goat with g, bag with b.

mcq.q: Why is a desk tidy good?
o: It keeps pens and pencils in one place.
It is a toy to throw.
mcq.why: A desk tidy helps us keep our things tidy.
